title: Negotiation outcomes
subtitle: Every AI price negotiation in this period: what it closed at, whether it became an order, and what each deal cost.
notOnPlan: AI price negotiation is not included in this shop's plan.
definitions: Discount from list is what the customer saved against your list price. Margin over cost is what you kept after the cost of goods and the payment processing fee, using the cost recorded when the negotiation started. They are different numbers. The totals above count redeemed deals only.

kpi.discountHint: What customers saved on redeemed deals
kpi.marginHint: What you kept after the cost of goods and payment fees
kpi.marginMissingCost: {count, plural, one {# redeemed deal has no cost and is left out} other {# redeemed deals have no cost and are left out}}

exportFailed: Could not export the negotiations. Try again.

columns.marginHint: (final price − cost) × quantity, less the deal's payment processing fee, using the cost recorded when the negotiation started

empty.title: No negotiations in this period
empty.body: When customers bargain with the AI negotiator, each session appears here with its outcome.

trend.title: Negotiations over time
trend.hint: Grouped by the day each negotiation started, so a deal counts on that day even if the order came later.

rollups.empty: Nothing to group in this period.
rollups.definitions: Averages are weighted by money and count redeemed deals only. Average discount is what customers saved as a share of the list price; average margin is what you kept after cost and payment fees as a share of the selling price. Closed at your floor counts deals agreed at the lowest price you allow.

columns.avgDiscountHint: Discount from list ÷ list value, on redeemed deals
columns.avgMarginHint: Margin after cost and payment fees ÷ selling price, on redeemed deals with a cost
